description: An elderly man in a long dark gown and black cap presses a small sheet of paper against a Gothic stone pillar. Behind him are a wooden screw press and a workbench in a dim workshop. The sheet carries rows of blackletter-like lines and a larger heading with letter-like shapes. It is a full-bleed oil painting with no frame or border.
